headline: Brazil tax calculation of 11.3% CBS raises fears of higher total VAT burden
summary: Calculations by Brazil's Court of Audit (TCU) estimate the new CBS tax rate at 11.3%, higher than the previous 9.21% projection. Tax experts warn this increases concerns over final corporate tax burdens.
why: Brazil is overhauling its consumption tax system into a dual VAT structure. Higher estimates for base tax rates directly affect corporate operational costs across sectors.
